slide_copy: Some couples don't pack. They relocate the house.
He packed chargers for gadgets they don't own.
Maybe love is two overpackers blaming the zip.

story_director_diagnosis.hook: Public contradiction: packing should be small; this couple relocates the house.
story_director_diagnosis.setup: A trip begins, but the real story is their shared overprepared delusion.
story_director_diagnosis.proof: Outfit options, impossible charger collection, toothbrush forgotten.
story_director_diagnosis.escalation: Both sit on the suitcase and blame the zip.
story_director_diagnosis.bridge: The joke turns from messy packing into same-team nonsense.
story_director_diagnosis.active_roles: Aachu overpacks appearance/weather options; Zuv overpacks tech/emergency logic; both create and defend the mess.
story_director_diagnosis.ending: The final line names a relationship identity, not a perfect-partner lesson.
story_director_diagnosis.send_save_reason: People can send it with 'us before every trip' or tag the partner who packs for imaginary situations.

visual_spine: Slide 1: suitcase open on the floor, clothes/cables/toiletries trying to escape, both characters in frame with confident planning energy.
Slide 2: she holds two or three outfit options as if all are essential; no glamour pose, only packing behavior.
Slide 3: he unrolls an absurd but tidy cable/charger collection like it is serious survival gear.
Slide 4: both sit or press on the suitcase to zip it; physical comedy is the main proof beat.
Slide 5: toothbrushes remain visibly on the bed/table outside the closed suitcase.
Slide 6: both point at the zip/suitcase with equal accusation; no one is the mature fixer.
Slide 7: both beside the overstuffed suitcase, amused and guilty, with the thesis in clean negative space.
negative_locks: No one partner fixing the other.
No pretty couple pose replacing the packing behavior.
No private names in public slide copy.
